question: There are so many star names in Re:Zero that, even though I already liked stars, I've come to enjoy looking at them even more. Do you have a favorite star or constellation?
answer:
I like the constellation Cassiopeia.

I've always liked looking at illustrated reference books about plants, animals, and so on, and among those, I especially liked books about stars because they had stories and episodes associated with each star and constellation.

Incidentally, when thinking of Subaru's name, I wanted something that could work for either a boy or a girl, and something that would work either way because surnames come afterward in the Re:Zero world.

There was actually an idea that when someone introduces themselves as “Natsuki Subaru” in the Re:Zero world, “Subaru” would be treated as the surname, so the characters in the Re world would think they were calling him by his surname. I had an episode like that in mind (as an idea), but I missed the opportunity to write it (laughs).

So when Otto calls him “Natsuki-san,” Otto thought he was getting close to him early on and calling him by his first name, but it was actually his surname! (laughs)
